export interface AssistantActivity {
    call_id: string;
    verb: string;
    target: string;
    state: "started" | "completed" | "failed" | "unknown";
    capability_id?: string;
    reason?: "not-authorized" | "declined" | "interrupted" | "unavailable";
    detail?: string;
    answer?: string;
    sequence?: number;
}

export interface AssistantBackgroundJob {
    job_id: string;
    work_id: string;
    title: string;
    state: "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "unknown";
    last_state?: string;
    started_at: string;
    ended_at?: string;
    card_id?: string;
}

export interface AssistantCard {
    card_id: string;
    revision: number;
    run_id: string | null;
    title: string;
    summary: string;
    provider: string;
    capability_title: string;
    capability_id: string;
    effect: "read" | "write" | "irreversible";
    fields: Array<{
        key: string;
        label: string;
        value: string;
        editable: boolean;
        raw?: string;
        options?: Array<{
            value: string;
            label: string;
        }>;
        input?: "date" | "datetime";
    }>;
    missing: Array<{
        field: string;
        question: string;
    }>;
    status: "ready" | "needs-input" | "running" | "done" | "failed" | "unknown" | "stale" | "dismissed";
    outcome?: string;
    from?: {
        surface: string;
        title?: string;
    };
    source_object?: {
        kind: string;
        id: string;
        version?: number | string | null;
        title?: string;
    };
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface AssistantRound {
    run_id: string;
    executor?: "assistant" | "coding";
    character?: AssistantCharacter;
    text: string;
    materials: Array<Pick<AssistantMaterial, "material_id" | "kind" | "title" | "explicit" | "draft" | "source" | "object">>;
    context: AssistantContextSnapshot | null;
    started_at: string;
    phase: AgentRunPhase | "unknown";
    turns: AgentTurnView[];
    activity: AssistantActivity[];
    awaiting_input: readonly AgentPendingQuestion[];
    steps?: Array<{
        id: string;
        text: string;
        state: "pending" | "in-progress" | "done" | "abandoned";
    }>;
    usage?: AgentRunUsage;
    stop_reason?: string;
    ended_at: string | null;
    memories_used?: {
        used: AssistantRoundMemory[];
        omitted: Array<AssistantRoundMemory & {
            reason: "budget" | "limit";
        }>;
    };
}

export interface AssistantRule {
    rule_id: string;
    kind: "quiet" | "pause";
    surfaces: string[];
    except: AssistantNoticeKind[];
    until?: string;
    label: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    created_at: string;
}

export type AssistantRuleInput = Pick<AssistantRule, "kind" | "surfaces" | "except" | "label"> & {
    until?: string;
    enabled?: boolean;
};

export type AssistantScope = {
    kind: "personal";
} | {
    kind: "project";
    project_id: string;
};

export interface AssistantWork {
    work_id: string;
    executor: AssistantExecutor;
    revision: number;
    title: string;
    scope: AssistantScope;
    scope_title?: string;
    origin: AssistantSurfaceRef | null;
    state: AssistantWorkState;

export interface AssistantWorkObject {
    relation: AssistantRelation;
    subject: {
        kind: string;
        id: string;
    };
    title: string;
    recorded_revision: string | null;
    current_revision: string | null;
    state: "current" | "changed" | "missing" | "unavailable" | "moved";
    moved_to?: {
        title: string;
        kind: "personal" | "project";
    };
    recorded_at: string;
    open?: {
        surface: string;
        id: string;
    };
}

export type AssistantWorkState = "idle" | "running" | "waiting-input" | "waiting-review" | "paused" | "completed" | "failed" | "stopped" | "needs-check";

export interface AssistantWorkView {
    work: AssistantWork;
    rounds: AssistantRound[];
    reviews: AssistantPendingReview[];
    cards: AssistantCard[];
    objects: AssistantWorkObject[];
    delegated?: Array<{
        work_id: string;
        title: string;
        state: AssistantWorkState;
        follow_ups: number;
        taken_back?: boolean;
    }>;
    scheduled?: AssistantFollowUp[];
    schedule_survives_close?: boolean;
    unsettled?: AssistantUnsettledChange[];
    undoable?: AssistantUndoable[];
    memory_candidates?: AssistantMemoryCandidate[];
    memory_changes?: MemoryChange[];
    jobs?: AssistantBackgroundJob[];
    usage?: {
        tokens: number;
        rounds: number;
        budget_tokens: number | null;
        budget_of?: {
            work_id: string;
            title: string;
        };
    };
    problem?: {
        message: string;
        action?: string;
    };
}
